issue: Hip flexors (iliopsoas) are a meaningful secondary mover but have no allowed bucket/latin value in the vocabulary, so they were omitted. Quads/adductors lightly engaged per some sources but considered minor and omitted to avoid inflation.

Original data listed Anterior Tibialis as secondary, but tibialis anterior is the antagonist (dorsiflexor), not a worked muscle, so it was removed. Fibularis (peroneals) included as stabilizer secondary.
